util.sync.none.title: No sync folder yet
util.sync.none.body: Choose a folder in the Sync folder section, then export to it or import from it.
util.sync.pending: Auto-export stopped: changes from another machine are waiting in the folder. Preview and import them first; Retry checks again.
util.sync.export.skipped.one: {count} file was left unchanged: the folder holds a newer edit, probably from another device. Import first, then export again.
util.sync.export.skipped.other: {count} files were left unchanged: the folder holds newer edits, probably from another device. Import first, then export again.
util.sync.import.hint: Import always shows a preview first. Nothing is applied until you press Import.
util.sync.import.rule: The newer copy wins, and the folder wins a tie. A conflict means this device is newer, so it is kept unless you choose the incoming copy.
util.sync.import.upToDate.title: Everything is up to date
util.sync.preview.label: Import preview
util.sync.removals: Delete local items missing from the files
util.sync.removals.warning: Items marked Removed will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
util.sync.col.name: Name
util.sync.change.added.hint: In the folder, not on this device
util.sync.change.removed.hint: On this device, not in the folder. Kept unless deletion is switched on
util.sync.change.conflict.hint: This device has the newer copy
util.sync.resolve.label: Resolution for {name}
util.sync.resolve.blocked.one: Confirm a choice for {count} conflict to import.
util.sync.resolve.blocked.other: Confirm a choice for {count} conflicts to import.
util.sync.hostChange.hint: Its keys are switched off on import and keep their values; switch one on after checking the new host. A new host also clears their console tokens and account ids.
util.sync.localKept.hint: Device settings in the file (such as the default permission mode) are never imported.
util.sync.deletedElsewhere.hint: This machine exported it to the folder and another machine has deleted it since. Auto-export waits until you apply the removal, or keep your copy with Export now.

util.console.emptyScript.title: No script output yet

util.runner.field.data.placeholder: Paste CSV or JSON, or load a file
util.runner.data.large: {name} is loaded. It is too large to edit here.
util.runner.collectionGone: This collection was deleted. Choose another collection.
util.runner.oneAtATime: A collection run is in progress. Only one can run at a time.

util.cookies.importBody: Paste a cookie jar export (JSON) or a Netscape cookies.txt from a browser, curl or wget. Cookies with the same name, domain and path are replaced.
util.cookies.col.name: Name
util.cookies.hostOnlyHint: Sent only to this exact host, never to its subdomains.
util.cookies.emptyBody: Cookies appear here when a response sets them.
util.cookies.noMatchBody: Try a name, a value or a domain.
util.cookies.loadFailedTitle: Could not load the cookie jar
util.cookies.add.title: Add cookies
util.cookies.add.body: Type one name=value, or paste a Cookie header from a browser to add each of its cookies. A cookie with the same name, domain and path is replaced.
util.cookies.add.targetHint: The host the cookies belong to, such as api.example.com or http://localhost:3000.
util.cookies.add.cookiesHint: name=value, or a Cookie header such as a=1; b=2.
util.cookies.add.subdomainsHint: Off: only this host gets the cookies (host-only).
util.cookies.add.empty: Enter a host and at least one name=value
util.cookies.add.errHost: Enter a host name or a URL
util.cookies.add.errChars: Names, values and the path cannot contain tabs or line breaks
util.cookies.field.expiresHint: An HTTP date. Empty makes it a session cookie.
util.cookies.field.maxAgeHint: Seconds from now, saved as an Expires date. Wins over Expires.
util.cookies.domainBody: {count} cookies of this domain will be removed. You can undo it right after.
util.cookies.clearBody: {count} expired cookies will be removed. You can undo it right after.
util.cookies.noneExpiredRemoved: No expired cookies were left to remove
util.certs.intro: CA certificates are trusted for all hosts or one host. A client certificate is sent to the hosts its pattern matches.
util.certs.emptyBody: Add one for services that use a self-signed certificate or ask for a client certificate.
util.certs.deleteBody: {path} stops being used. The file itself stays where it is.
util.certs.field.hostCaHint: Empty or * trusts the CA for every host.
util.certs.field.hostClientHint: A host such as api.example.com, or *.internal.corp:8443.
util.certs.field.certClientHint: A PEM certificate with its key file, or a .p12/.pfx bundle that holds both.
util.certs.field.passphraseHint: Only needed when the key file or the .p12/.pfx bundle is protected by a passphrase. Write-only: it is never shown again.
util.certs.passphrase.stored: Stored on this Mac. Never shown again.
util.certs.passphrase.removed: The stored passphrase is removed when you save.
util.certs.err.host: A client certificate needs a host pattern
util.certs.err.key: A client certificate needs its private key file
util.certs.fixFirst: Fill in the required fields first
util.import.title: Import
util.import.hint.postman: A Postman Collection v2.1 file. Scripts, auth, variables, descriptions, order, saved examples and redirect and TLS settings are kept; assertions exported by PingDeck come back as assertions.
util.import.hint.curl: One cURL command, with line continuations, headers, body and basic auth.
util.import.hint.openapi: An OpenAPI 2.0 (Swagger) or 3.x document, JSON or YAML. Tags become folders; servers become a baseUrl variable.
util.import.hint.har: A HAR capture. Entries are grouped by host into folders.
util.import.hint.environment: A Postman environment export, or JSON with a name and values.
util.import.hint.mockoon: A Mockoon environment file. It becomes a stopped mock server.
util.import.hint.insomnia: An Insomnia v4 JSON export. Request groups become folders and the base environment becomes collection variables; template tags and sub-environments are listed, not imported.
util.import.hint.bruno: A Bruno collection exported as JSON. Folders, requests, auth, docs and status assertions are kept; Bruno scripts are kept as written.
util.import.hint.hoppscotch: A Hoppscotch collection export (one collection or several). Folders, requests and auth are kept; Hoppscotch variables become PingDeck variables.
util.import.placeholder: Paste the document here, or load a file
util.import.scriptsNote: Imported scripts are kept but never run by the import. They run only when you send a request.
util.import.needText: Paste a document or load a file first
util.import.newWorkspace: Goes into a new workspace “{name}”: there is no workspace yet.
util.import.p.name: Name
util.import.secrets: {count} variables are marked secret. Their values are left empty.
util.import.scripts: The file contains scripts. They are kept and run only when you send a request.
util.import.auth: Authorization used: {kinds}. Check it after the import.
util.import.clash.updateHint: Refreshes the existing collection from the file. Paired requests keep their ids, assertions, scripts and filled-in values; new ones are added and nothing is removed. You can undo it.
util.import.clash.matched.one: {count} request of the file pairs with an existing one.
util.import.clash.matched.other: {count} requests of the file pair with existing ones.
util.import.clash.bothHint: Adds a second one next to the existing one.
util.import.clash.replaceHint: Removes the existing one and imports this.
util.import.clash.skipHint: Imports nothing and keeps the existing one.
util.import.done.withMock: Imported “{name}” and created the mock server “{mock}” (stopped)
util.export.title: Export
util.export.collectionHint: Written as a Postman Collection v2.1 file.
util.export.extraHint: Collection variables are always included. An environment adds its variables and overrides collection values of the same name; secret values are left empty.
util.export.secretsHint: Off by default: secret values are left empty in the file.
util.export.secretsWarning: The file will contain secrets. Share it only with people who may see them.
util.export.noCollection: There is no collection to export
util.export.noEnvironment: There is no environment to export
util.import.done.replaced.one: {count} other collection of that name was removed
util.import.done.replaced.other: {count} other collections of that name were removed
util.import.hint.pingdeck: A mock server file exported from PingDeck. Servers are imported stopped.
util.import.mockoonNote: Mockoon: proxy and callbacks stay off after the import. Review them before turning them on.
util.import.withMockHint: A new stopped mock server answers each operation with the document’s example. No forwarding, no callbacks.
util.import.notPingdeck: This is not a PingDeck mock server export.
util.export.mockHint: Written as a PingDeck mock server file. Bring it back with Import…
util.export.noMock: There is no mock server to export
util.import.goes.draft: A new draft tab. You pick where it goes when you save it.
util.import.clash.replaceUndoHint: The collection becomes exactly the file: paired requests keep their ids, the others are removed. You can undo from the done page or the toast.
util.import.clash.flowSteps.one: {count} flow step calls a request that goes away; undo brings it back.
util.import.clash.flowSteps.other: {count} flow steps call requests that go away; undo brings them back.
util.import.undone: Put “{name}” back as it was before the import
util.import.compat.title: Script compatibility
util.import.compat.hint: These calls fail when the script runs.
util.export.literalHint: Off by default: tokens and passwords typed into Auth or credential headers are left empty. Variable references stay.
util.export.literalWarning: The file will contain the tokens and passwords typed into Auth. Share it only with people who may see them.
util.export.mockLiteralHint: Off by default: tokens typed into credential headers of the proxy and of callbacks are left empty. Variable references stay.
util.export.mockLiteralWarning: The file will contain the tokens typed into proxy and callback headers. Share it only with people who may see them.
